WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, lap_type
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race'
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
           LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position,
           LEAD(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS next_position
    FROM race_laps
    WHERE lap > 0
),
position_diff AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, prev_position,
           CASE WHEN position > prev_position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overtaken_this_lap,
           CASE WHEN position < prev_position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overtaking_this_lap
    FROM position_changes
    WHERE prev_position IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT driver_id,
       SUM(overtaken_this_lap) AS total_overtaken,
       SUM(overtaking_this_lap) AS total_overtaking
FROM position_diff
GROUP BY driver_id
HAVING SUM(overtaken_this_lap) > SUM(overtaking_this_lap)
ORDER BY total_overtaken DESC
LIMIT 20
